eval_ha_giang_3d.rationale: Hà Giang has 0 verified POIs in gomate_places_freeze_v2.json and cannot be grounded against REC-A-CORE-V2.

eval_moc_chau_3d.rationale: Mộc Châu has 0 verified POIs in gomate_places_freeze_v2.json and cannot be grounded against REC-A-CORE-V2.

eval_da_nang_4d.rationale: May be used as design evidence, but is not automatically counted as one of the final frozen 100 scenarios until a dedicated scenario-freeze task explicitly validates and freezes the 100-scenario benchmark (noting its current required_keyword 'Hội An' refers to non-core POIs).

POI_VISIT.description: Activity represents visit or use of a specific physical place.

TRANSIT_ONLY.anti_gaming_rule: TRANSIT_ONLY must never represent a named attraction, restaurant, cafe, museum, park, venue, or any other visitable POI to evade the grounding denominator.

unknown_or_missing_activity_kind_policy.explanation: Any itinerary item with a missing or unknown activity_kind in a final benchmark output is classified as INVALID_OR_SCHEMA_NONCOMPLIANT_ITEM and fails closed; it may never silently escape the grounding denominator.

CATALOG_GROUNDING.grounding_definition: Every itinerary item with activity_kind == 'POI_VISIT' is grounded if and only if (1) it carries a non-empty canonical place_id field and (2) that place_id exists in the frozen evaluation catalog (REC-A-CORE-V2).

scenario_level_metric.name: ALL_POIS_GROUNDED
scenario_level_metric.definition: true if and only if all itinerary items have valid controlled activity_kind, the scenario contains >= 1 POI_VISIT item, and every POI_VISIT item has a valid grounded canonical place_id in the frozen catalog.

DESTINATION_CORRECTNESS.definition: For every grounded POI_VISIT item's place_id in the itinerary, the catalog record's destination_slug must equal the requested benchmark scenario destination_slug.

scenario_level_metric.name: scenario_destination_valid
scenario_level_metric.definition: true if and only if all POI_VISIT items are grounded and every grounded POI_VISIT item belongs to the requested scenario destination.

DUPLICATE_POI.default_benchmark_policy: The same canonical place_id must not appear more than once across POI_VISIT items in an entire itinerary unless a future scenario explicitly preregisters revisits as allowed.

SCHEDULE_VALIDITY.intra_day_non_overlap_requirement: Within the same itinerary day, any two timed activity intervals [start_time_i, end_time_i) and [start_time_j, end_time_j) must not overlap (end_time_earlier <= start_time_later).
SCHEDULE_VALIDITY.scenario_pass_condition: Scenario schedule PASS if and only if zero TIME_PARSE_INVALID, zero TIME_INTERVAL_INVALID, and zero SCHEDULE_OVERLAP occur across all days of the itinerary.

DAY_STRUCTURE.claim_boundary: Structural completeness verification only; passing DAY_STRUCTURE does NOT imply semantic itinerary quality.

budget_semantics.definition: For scenarios specifying a user budget ceiling, the sum of the planner's own declared item estimated_cost values across the itinerary must be <= the requested scenario budget ceiling.
budget_semantics.what_it_measures: Compliance of the planner's own declared estimated_cost values with the requested budget ceiling.
budget_semantics.what_it_does_not_measure: Real-world price correctness or factual grounding against external/catalog ticket or meal prices.

separate_engineering_check.definition: Verifies that each day_cost equals the sum of its items' estimated_cost values and budget_analysis.estimated_cost equals the sum of day_cost values.

per_item_state_definitions.COMPLIANT: Opening-hours evidence exists in the frozen catalog, is parseable, the scheduled visit interval and date/day-of-week are known, and the visit interval complies with the open hours.
per_item_state_definitions.VIOLATION: Opening-hours evidence exists in the frozen catalog, is parseable, the scheduled visit interval and date/day-of-week are known, and the visit interval conflicts with the known open hours.
per_item_state_definitions.UNKNOWN: Required opening-hours evidence or parseability is absent.

known_violation_contract.rule: Any known opening-hours VIOLATION on an evaluable POI_VISIT item (opening_hours_known_violation_count > 0) MUST cause CORE_SCENARIO_PASS = false.

opening_hours_semantics.global_hard_scenario_pass_inclusion_poli: EVIDENCE_CONDITIONAL_HARD: UNKNOWN items are excluded from the compliance denominator and remain neutral with respect to CORE_SCENARIO_PASS, whereas any known VIOLATION on an evaluable item (opening_hours_known_violation_count > 0) MUST cause CORE_SCENARIO_PASS = false.

hard_roadmap_grounding_gate.pass_condition: grounded_poi_rate == 1.0 (over all POI_VISIT items across the final 100-scenario primary benchmark)
hard_roadmap_grounding_gate.other_dimensions_threshold_policy: Do not invent arbitrary numerical pass thresholds for schedule, estimated-budget, or diagnostic dimensions; report point estimates and confidence intervals.

item_level_grounded_poi_rate_uncertainty.rationale: Multiple POI_VISIT items within one generated itinerary originate from the same model call and cannot be treated as independent Bernoulli observations for inferential uncertainty.

statistical_reporting_contract.equal_destination_macro_average_rational: Prevents the 34/33/33 scenario allocation from slightly over-weighting ha-noi relative to da-nang and ha-long.
statistical_reporting_contract.significance_testing_policy: No statistical significance claim may be made unless a specific comparison hypothesis is formally preregistered prior to final benchmark execution.

latency.measurement_boundary: Measured directly around the live provider API call inside the benchmark harness.

valid_and_invalid_run_contract.retry_policy_rule: Zero silent retries allowed; any retry behavior must be explicitly preregistered and logged before final benchmark execution.

required_instrumentation_prerequisites.requirement: Controlled activity_kind ('POI_VISIT' | 'TRANSIT_ONLY') on every itinerary item, with canonical place_id REQUIRED iff activity_kind == 'POI_VISIT' (and fail-closed INVALID_OR_SCHEMA_NONCOMPLIANT_ITEM on missing/unknown activity_kind).
Deterministic catalog membership validation against frozen REC-A-CORE-V2 catalog for all POI_VISIT items.
Destination membership validation by canonical place_id for all POI_VISIT items.
Canonical duplicate-place validation by place_id across POI_VISIT items.
HH:MM time parser, start_time < end_time validator, and intra-day interval overlap checker.
Estimated-budget ceiling checker separate from real-world price-grounding claims.
Opening-hours parser with explicit three-state (COMPLIANT / VIOLATION / UNKNOWN) handling where known VIOLATION fails CORE_SCENARIO_PASS and UNKNOWN remains neutral.
Benchmark harness that rejects mock/fallback execution (FAIL CLOSED on MOCK_OR_FALLBACK_RUN) and retains invalid runs in the primary 100-scenario denominator.
Raw provider response and parsed PlanResponse output persistence for evaluation runs.
Cryptographic reproducibility run manifest capturing all required SHA256 digests and run metadata.
Frozen 100-scenario benchmark manifest (34 ha-noi, 33 da-nang, 33 ha-long) with per-scenario SHA256.
Benchmark-only execution path that cannot accidentally return canned mock responses as scientific evidence.

clarified_points.grounding_item_universe: Controlled activity_kind ('POI_VISIT' | 'TRANSIT_ONLY'); Grounded POI Rate denominator is all POI_VISIT items; unknown/missing activity_kind is INVALID_OR_SCHEMA_NONCOMPLIANT_ITEM
clarified_points.budget_operationalization: ESTIMATED_BUDGET_COMPLIANCE (sum of planner-declared item estimated_cost <= requested budget ceiling; no claim of real-world price accuracy because catalog numeric price coverage is 0/759)
clarified_points.opening_hours_unknown_and_violation_poli: EVIDENCE_CONDITIONAL_HARD three-state (COMPLIANT / VIOLATION / UNKNOWN); UNKNOWN is excluded from compliance denominator and neutral to CORE_SCENARIO_PASS, whereas any known VIOLATION on an evaluable item causes CORE_SCENARIO_PASS = false
clarified_points.travel_time_policy: TRAVEL_TIME and ROUTE_DISTANCE are NOT_EVALUABLE in W06 V1 due to absence of road-network routing data; Haversine is strictly GEO_DISTANCE_PROXY (diagnostic only)
clarified_points.preference_satisfaction_policy: NOT_PRIMARY_EVALUABLE because all 300 preference records are synthetic (0 verified real-user preference GT)
